title: n8n Azure Storage node fails with custom endpoint error on a Shared Key credential set to Custom cloud
symptoms: Azure Storage Shared Key credential with Azure Cloud set to Custom fails with a clear error when used
Private endpoint or custom domain storage account will not connect
cause: From 2.40, the Shared Key credential has an Azure Cloud dropdown. Custom endpoints only work when an admin enables N8N_AZURE_STORAGE_CUSTOM_ENDPOINTS_ENABLED, which defaults to off. Only host-style endpoints are supported.
fix: Set the environment variable to true on the n8n instance and restart, and use a host-style endpoint URL.
affected: n8n 2.40 and later, self-hosted instances using custom or private Azure Storage endpoints
